10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11048|2479a86b.name: Victor Ward
11048|2479a86b.text: Yes, I think you have potential. Maybe I can show you a thing or two.

11048|f49c9bcc.name: Victor Ward
11048|f49c9bcc.text: I'm just a student myself, really. Rhiannon's the expert. She's standing by the crates over there. You can learn a lot from her.

11049|041039a1.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|041039a1.text: How can I share my secrets with a beginner? Try speaking with Victor Ward first.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

1226|5d01ce11.name: Maxan Anvol
1226|5d01ce11.text: I hope the Light is with you, $N. Is there anything I can do for you today?

1234|ea9bf72c.name: Hogral Bakkan
1234|ea9bf72c.text: Can't help ya, $N. I only train rogues.

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1744|06ca4e17.name: Deathguard Mort
1744|06ca4e17.text: You'll find the $C Trainer, Cain Firesong, upstairs on the landing at the Gallows' End Tavern, which is on the southeast end of Brill.  I guess he checked in too late to get a room.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1950|aa9cd6e2.name: Rane Yorick
1950|aa9cd6e2.text: My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse.  The Deathstalkers need your help.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2122|0e675a71.name: David Trias
2122|0e675a71.text: I can not train you. You need to talk to your class trainer.

2124|7d510daf.name: Isabella
2124|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

2128|7d510daf.name: Cain Firesong
2128|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

223|23e08fe6.name: Dan Golthas
223|23e08fe6.text: When I clawed my way out of the grave, I thought my family would welcome me with open arms. Instead, they drove me from the village, screaming in a language I could no longer understand.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

244808|942bf955.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|942bf955.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

246152|942bf955.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|942bf955.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.
251001|379c835f.title: I need a report for Executor Zygand.

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

267324|0371bf6f.name: Margaret Weaver
267324|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3296|c407ea01.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c407ea01.text: Speak to Pephredo at the Darkbriar Lodge in the Valley of Spirits, up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3338|e2ff6310.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3338|e2ff6310.text: The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3523|02cc6c56.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|02cc6c56.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. May I help you?

3523|a670d938.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|a670d938.text: So... you want to be a tailor? Very well, we'll see if you have what it takes.

3523|c39c33e0.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|c39c33e0.text: I am knowledgable, but I am not an expert. You know who you should talk to? Rhiannon! She's not far. Ask around for her in Undercity

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3557|a43ce262.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|a43ce262.text: Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4556|3dfe0528.name: Gordon Wendham
4556|3dfe0528.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

4568|7d510daf.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

4576|4eaf08fa.name: Josef Gregorian
4576|4eaf08fa.text: I will instruct you when the time is right... that time is not now. You have much more to learn first!

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5688|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5695|0a25fc55.name: Vance Undergloom
5695|0a25fc55.text: Greetings, traveler! Care to delve into the mysteries of the arcane? Hm?

5885|f341dff7.name: Deino
5885|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1358-accept.name: Apothecary Zinge
1358-accept.text:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
1358-accept.title: Sample for Helbrim

1358-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1358-complete.text:
Ah, very good.  If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, $N.  Your reward is well earned.
1358-complete.title: Sample for Helbrim

1358-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1358-progress.text: You have a package for me?
1358-progress.title: Sample for Helbrim

1359-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1359-accept.text:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
1359-accept.title: Zinge's Delivery

1359-complete.name: Apothecary Zinge
1359-complete.text: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.
1359-complete.title: Zinge's Delivery

1881-accept.name: Cain Firesong
1881-accept.text: $N, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents.  Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.
1881-accept.title: Speak with Anastasia

1881-complete.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1881-complete.text: Greetings, $N.  You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...
1881-complete.title: Speak with Anastasia

1882-accept.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1882-accept.text:
The Plaguelands to the east are an aberration.  Devised by the Lich King, they spread their magic into the soil, corrupting and killing all that live.  Although there is a certain charm to the destructive forces of the plague, we, the mages of the Forsaken, believe it is unruly and must be curtailed.

But first, we must measure how far it has spread into Tirisfal.  Go to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal.  In the garden are flowers--snapdragons.  Gather these and return.
1882-accept.title: The Balnir Farmstead

1882-complete.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1882-complete.text:
Ah, a fine specimen this is.  I will send it to be studied by our apothecaries to determine the extent of the Plagueland's taint.

Well done, $N.  For your services, I present to you this choice: an orb or staff.  Whichever you choose, you will find it quite useful.
1882-complete.title: The Balnir Farmstead

1882-progress.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1882-progress.text: Do you have the snapdragons?  That breed of flower is highly receptive to magic energies, and studying the snapdragons so close to the Plaguelands can tell us if the plague has entered Tirisfal Glades.
1882-progress.title: The Balnir Farmstead

1960-accept.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1960-accept.text:
Algernon's alchemist shop in the Apothecarium is the locus of a strange disturbance.  Invisible creatures, made solely of magic, wander the shop--there must be a reason, and we must find it!

Investigate the disturbance and capture those creatures.  Take a chest of coffers and a scroll from behind me.  Use the scroll at the shop to make the creatures visible, subdue them with your spells, then throw down a coffer to capture them.  Return with the filled coffers, the empty coffers and the cantation.
1960-accept.title: Investigate the Alchemist Shop

1960-complete.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1960-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  The creatures within these containment coffers will be studied by our finest minds, and the reason behind their presence in the Undercity will be determined.

If their appearance is caused by a rift in the natural flow of magic, then we must determine if the rift was random.  If it was not random, but instead an attack by some magical force, then we must prepare for future, more serious disturbances.
1960-complete.title: Investigate the Alchemist Shop

1960-progress.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1960-progress.text: Have you investigated the disturbance, $N?  Have you captured the creatures?
1960-progress.title: Investigate the Alchemist Shop

1961-accept.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1961-accept.text:
It is time for you to don your first $c's robes, $N.  They are a sign of your station, and a testament to your worth.

To gain the robes, you must gather the mana gems from the Dalaran mages of Silverpine.  Their beliefs are similar to ours and so killing them is somewhat distasteful, but if they lack the strength to resist us, then they do not deserve their lives.

Bring the gems and a supply of linen to Josef Gregorian at the Magic Quarter's tailor shop.
1961-accept.title: Gathering Materials

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

310-complete.name: Unknown
310-complete.text: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
310-complete.title: Bitter Rivals

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

311-accept.name: Unknown
311-accept.text: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
311-accept.title: Return to Marleth

319-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
319-complete.title: A Favor for Evershine

320-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
320-accept.text: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
320-accept.title: Return to Bellowfiz

3221-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
3221-accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
3221-accept.title: Speak with Renferrel

3221-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
3221-complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
3221-complete.title: Speak with Renferrel

354-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
354-accept.text:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
354-accept.title: Deaths in the Family

354-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
354-complete.text:
Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
354-complete.title: Deaths in the Family

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

355-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
355-accept.text:
You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
355-accept.title: Speak with Sevren

355-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
355-complete.text:
Coleman speaks well of you, $N, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
355-complete.title: Speak with Sevren

356-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-accept.text:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
356-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

356-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-complete.text: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
356-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

357-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-accept.text:
There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other $R are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.

But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.

To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
357-accept.title: The Lich's Identity

358-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-accept.text:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
358-accept.title: Graverobbers

358-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-complete.text:
Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, well done.  But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
358-complete.title: Graverobbers

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

359-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
359-accept.text:
I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.
359-accept.title: Forsaken Duties

359-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
359-complete.text:
Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
359-complete.title: Forsaken Duties

360-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
360-accept.text:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
360-accept.title: Return to the Magistrate

360-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
360-complete.text:
It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

But we will not give in.  He will not take us again!
360-complete.title: Return to the Magistrate

361-accept.name: Unknown
361-accept.text: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand.  It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
361-accept.title: A Letter Undelivered

361-complete.name: Yvette Farthing
361-complete.text:
Oh...my poor Thurman!  I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong!  And I knew it!  I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!!  Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!

<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>

But regrets are for the weak.  As a Forsaken, I have new goals and love is not one of them.  I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.

But that life is over.  Forever.
361-complete.title: A Letter Undelivered

362-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
362-accept.text:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
362-accept.title: The Haunted Mills

362-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
362-complete.text:
Thank you.  Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed.  They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
362-complete.title: The Haunted Mills

365-accept.name: Deathguard Simmer
365-accept.text:
What have we here?  You look like a fledgling $c.  If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

To the west you'll find a farm.  Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse.  And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower.  Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.

Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
365-accept.title: Fields of Grief

365-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-complete.text: You have performed your bidding well, young $c.  You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
365-complete.title: Fields of Grief

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
367-accept.title: A New Plague

367-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-complete.text: You have done well $N, and I thank you for your efforts.
367-complete.title: A New Plague

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-accept.text:
While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.

I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity.  You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
368-accept.title: A New Plague

368-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-complete.text: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
368-complete.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-accept.text:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
369-accept.title: A New Plague

369-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-complete.text: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
369-complete.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

370-accept.name: Executor Zygand
370-accept.text:
The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.

Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
370-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

370-complete.name: Executor Zygand
370-complete.text: Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady.  You have performed your duty well, $c.
370-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-accept.name: Executor Zygand
371-accept.text:
We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
371-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-complete.name: Executor Zygand
371-complete.text: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit.  But other threats loom.
371-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

372-accept.name: Executor Zygand
372-accept.text:
Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
372-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

372-complete.name: Executor Zygand
372-complete.text: You have done extremely well, $c.  With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The Forsaken our race is one step closer to defeating Arthas once and for all.  I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
372-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-accept.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-accept.text:
Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
374-accept.title: Proof of Demise

374-complete.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-complete.text: Varimathras would be proud.  You serve your leaders well, $c.
374-complete.title: Proof of Demise

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-accept.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-accept.text:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, $N, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
375-accept.title: The Chill of Death

375-complete.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-complete.text: I appreciate your efforts, $N.  May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
375-complete.title: The Chill of Death

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

380-complete.name: Executor Arren
380-complete.text:
Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.

You've done your duty well, $N, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
380-complete.title: Night Web's Hollow

381-accept.name: Executor Arren
381-accept.text:
You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts.  We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every $r--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. We must strike first!

Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
381-accept.title: The Scarlet Crusade

381-complete.name: Executor Arren
381-complete.text:
If only they listened to reason, eh, $N? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... ha!

Light-blinded fools.
381-complete.title: The Scarlet Crusade

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

382-accept.name: Executor Arren
382-accept.text:
Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!

You're the most qualified person I have to send, $N. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
382-accept.title: The Red Messenger

382-complete.name: Executor Arren
382-complete.text:
Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

<He begins to rifle through the documents you recovered.>

Some news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.
382-complete.title: The Red Messenger

383-accept.name: Executor Arren
383-accept.text:
These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.

Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
383-accept.title: Vital Intelligence

383-complete.name: Executor Zygand
383-complete.text:
Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, $N. Hmm... names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...

Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.
383-complete.title: Vital Intelligence

384-complete.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-complete.text:
The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
384-complete.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

3902-complete.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-complete.text: Great work $N, I knew you weren't useless.  Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
3902-complete.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

398-accept.name: Unknown
398-accept.text:
Wanted: Maggot Eye!

A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken.  This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army.  Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.

The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution.  Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

Mercy is for the weak.
398-accept.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

398-complete.name: Executor Zygand
398-complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.
398-complete.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

404-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-accept.text:
Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.

Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
404-accept.title: A Putrid Task

404-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-complete.text: Well done.  I regret not being there to see you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
404-complete.title: A Putrid Task

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

405-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
405-accept.text:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful $c in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
405-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-complete.text:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren.  Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
405-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

407-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
407-accept.text:
Harmless pumpkins, right?  Or so it would seem.  If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.

With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady.  This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.

Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.  Take this pumpkin to the fool.
407-accept.title: Fields of Grief

407-complete.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-complete.text: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
407-complete.title: Fields of Grief

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

408-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-accept.text:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
408-accept.title: The Family Crypt

408-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-complete.text:
Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge.  And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.

Continue the struggle as we all do, $N, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
408-complete.title: The Family Crypt

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

421-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-complete.text: You have served me well, $c.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
421-complete.title: Prove Your Worth

422-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-accept.text:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
422-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

422-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-complete.text: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, $c.  If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
422-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

422-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-progress.text: Before I know what we are dealing with here, $c, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal.  Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
422-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

423-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-accept.text:
After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed.  The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour.  Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic.  I need to examine these items first hand.  Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research.  The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
423-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

423-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-complete.text:
I hope I can acquire enough energy from such a limited sample.  Perhaps I should have had you get more shackles.

Nonetheless, you showed great skill in collecting these, $c.
423-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-accept.text:
It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.

But in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered.  It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.

The mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.

I want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale.  With his death, the mine shall be ours.
424-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

424-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-complete.text: Most excellent.  The mine will provide superb resources for our forces as we spread throughout Silverpine and into Azeroth.
424-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-accept.name: Rane Yorick
425-accept.text:
My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec.  But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn.  He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal.  Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.
425-accept.title: Ivar the Foul

425-complete.name: Rane Yorick
425-complete.text:
Ah, thank you.  You have my gratitude, $N.

And I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
425-complete.title: Ivar the Foul

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

426-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-accept.text:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
426-accept.title: The Mills Overrun

426-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-complete.text: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
426-complete.title: The Mills Overrun

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

427-accept.name: Executor Zygand
427-accept.text:
The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade.  We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

But the Deathguard has larger concerns.  The Lich King's army grows in number each night.  We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.
427-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

427-complete.name: Executor Zygand
427-complete.text: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
427-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

429-accept.name: Rane Yorick
429-accept.text:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
429-accept.title: Wild Hearts

429-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-complete.text:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment.
429-complete.title: Wild Hearts

429-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-progress.text: My time is short, $c, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.
429-progress.title: Wild Hearts

430-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
430-accept.text:
Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
430-accept.title: Return to Quinn

430-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
430-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

<A few moments pass in suspenseful silence.>
430-complete.title: Return to Quinn

430-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
430-progress.text: My sister told me you were here to aid us.  Is that true?
430-progress.title: Return to Quinn

435-accept.name: Deathstalker Erland
435-accept.text:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
435-accept.title: Escorting Erland

435-complete.name: Rane Yorick
435-complete.text: Thank you for the aid, $N.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.
435-complete.title: Escorting Erland

437-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-accept.text:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
437-accept.title: The Dead Fields

437-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-complete.text:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, $N, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day.  Your value to the Forsaken grows.
437-complete.title: The Dead Fields

437-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-progress.text: Have you defeated Nightlash, $N?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
437-progress.title: The Dead Fields

438-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
438-accept.text:
$N, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other $r.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
438-accept.title: The Decrepit Ferry

438-complete.name: Unknown
438-complete.text:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
438-complete.title: The Decrepit Ferry

439-accept.name: Unknown
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-complete.text:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
439-complete.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-progress.text: $N.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
439-progress.title: Rot Hide Clues

440-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
440-accept.text:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's $r he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
440-accept.title: The Engraved Ring

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

445-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
445-accept.text:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
445-accept.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-complete.text:
Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research.  With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades.  Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.

But you must excuse my rambling.  Extend your stay in Silverpine, $N.  We could use an able bodied $c like you around here.
445-complete.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

447-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
447-accept.text:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
447-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

447-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-complete.text: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, $N.  These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause.  I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.
447-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

447-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
447-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

449-accept.name: Rane Yorick
449-accept.text: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
449-accept.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-complete.text:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, $N.  And you will be commended.
449-complete.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-progress.text: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
449-progress.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

450-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
450-accept.text:
You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, $N.

When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard.  Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us.  But his findings might prove to be of worth.  He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
450-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

477-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-accept.text:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
477-accept.title: Border Crossings

477-complete.name: Unknown
477-complete.text:
<Prying open the lid of the crate, you find an assortment of carefully-packed objects. On the top of the crate lies a bundle of maps, yellowing with age, that appear to depict Silverpine Forest and other parts of western Lordaeron.

Underneath the maps is a mysterious-looking magical pendant.>
477-complete.title: Border Crossings

478-accept.name: Unknown
478-accept.text: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
478-accept.title: Maps and Runes

478-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
478-complete.text:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
478-complete.title: Maps and Runes

479-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-accept.text:
Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.

Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
479-accept.title: Ambermill Investigations

481-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
481-accept.text: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
481-accept.title: Dalar's Analysis

481-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
481-complete.text:
Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
481-complete.title: Dalar's Analysis

482-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
482-accept.text:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
482-accept.title: Dalaran's Intentions

482-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
482-complete.text:
Ill news you bring, $N. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
482-complete.title: Dalaran's Intentions

492-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
492-accept.text:
According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
492-accept.title: A New Plague

492-complete.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-complete.text: Ah, a drink at last.  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
492-complete.title: A New Plague

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

5481-accept.name: Gordo
5481-accept.text:
Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.

When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.
5481-accept.title: Gordo's Task

5481-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-complete.text:
What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
5481-complete.title: Gordo's Task

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

5482-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-accept.text:
So you can see the predicament that I'm in, $N. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.

It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
5482-accept.title: Doom Weed

5482-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
5482-complete.title: Doom Weed

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

5722-accept.name: Rythalor
5722-accept.text:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722-accept.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5722-complete.name: Unknown
5722-complete.text:
The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.

You begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.
5722-complete.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723-accept.name: Rythalor
5723-accept.text:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723-accept.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5723-complete.name: Rahauro
5723-complete.text:
I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. Thank you, $N. I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.

Perhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.
5723-complete.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5724-accept.name: Unknown
5724-accept.text:
You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.

Removing the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
5724-accept.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5724-complete.name: Rahauro
5724-complete.text:
Excellent, $N. Thank you.

Magatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. Please, take it in thanks.
5724-complete.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5724-progress.name: Rahauro
5724-progress.text: Were you able to find anything, $N? Any clues as to why one of her clansman had to die needlessly would be helpful.
5724-progress.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5725-accept.name: Varimathras
5725-accept.text:
Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.

A sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
5725-accept.title: The Power to Destroy...

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5726-complete.name: Thrall
5726-complete.text:
Good, $N! The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? You remind me of myself when I was younger. I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.

But there is time for more praise later. You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.
5726-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5726-progress.name: Thrall
5726-progress.text:
Do you have the insignia yet, $N?

It will be a vital tool in infiltrating what I believe is the greatest threat to the Horde, and finally finding peace in our new home.

You will learn how intricate a web men and orcs alike can weave when they are motivated by greed and power. The hidden agendas, the corruption, all of it will become clear. You will find yourself in the midst of a war you never knew existed.
5726-progress.title: Hidden Enemies

5727-accept.name: Thrall
5727-accept.text:
Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.

There is a warlock within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.

Take this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in Orgrimmar, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
5727-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5727-complete.name: Thrall
5727-complete.text:
Excellent! Most excellent, $c!

What you have done this day is only the first step in a much broader foundation--a foundation that we will build the destruction of the Shadow Council on, once and for all.

Tell me all he said... and leave not one word out--it may be more important than you realize.
5727-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5728-accept.name: Thrall
5728-accept.text:
Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.

Return to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, $N. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his brothers in arms.
5728-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5728-complete.name: Thrall
5728-complete.text: I am glad you've returned, $N. Some of those loyal to me brought word immediately that the caverns below Orgrimmar were in disarray now that their leaders have been slain. I even heard reports that Neeru was more than agitated. It seems we've put a dent in his armor. I can't say I'm displeased... even with such a minor victory.
5728-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5729-accept.name: Thrall
5729-accept.text:
I think our next step should be to have you placed close to Neeru. If he is as agitated as reports suggest, then we may accomplish two things. One, you may be able to gain some greater knowledge about the Council or at least the Burning Blade, and two, he may just begin to trust you enough that he asks you to start to aid him. He may very well look at you as someone who can fill the void now that some of the leadership is in turmoil.

Return to the Cleft and speak to him again, but do not be too overt.
5729-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5729-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
5729-complete.text: What is it?! Oh, you, $c... my apologies. My anger rivals that of a rabid kodo bull... but perhaps it is my own fault. In sending travelers into Ragefire Chasm, I should have seen the possibility that some harm would come from it. It seems both Bazzalan and Jergosh were taken unaware and slain by some of Thrall's do-gooders. A most inopportune time, but there is nothing that can be done about it now.
5729-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5730-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5730-accept.text:
You are one of my lieutenants! Prepare yourself, $c. I will call upon you soon.

My time spent on the Searing Blade may be all but wasted now, but that does not mean that the Shadow Council's schemes elsewhere must suffer. I will do what I can to minimize the damage here in Ragefire Chasm. In the meantime, I will have my agents in the Barrens and Ashenvale begin work on our newest agenda. Return to me soon.
5730-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5730-complete.name: Thrall
5730-complete.text:
Ashenvale? Hmm, I had not heard of any presence of the Council or the Burning Blade in Ashenvale. My spies will investigate, $N. You have done well.

For now, rest, and keep yourself occupied with other tasks. I will call upon you again soon.

Lok-Tar Ogar!
5730-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-accept.text:
The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence.
