The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
5761-accept.title: Slaying the Beast

5761-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-complete.text:
Ha! You've done it! Thrall will be so pleased.

I will ensure this heart is taken care of properly.

For now though, you must celebrate your victory. I will inform Thrall of your success.

Thank you for your aid, $c.
5761-complete.title: Slaying the Beast

5761-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-progress.text: Have you killed the beast? He surely must be the leader of the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm.
5761-progress.title: Slaying the Beast

6321-accept.name: Deathguard Podrig
6321-accept.text:
Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher.  With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.

I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.  Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.
6321-accept.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-complete.name: Karos Razok
6321-complete.text: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
6321-complete.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6322-accept.name: Gordon Wendham
6322-accept.text:
I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.

Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
6322-accept.title: Michael Garrett

6322-complete.name: Michael Garrett
6322-complete.text: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine?  That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
6322-complete.title: Michael Garrett

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-accept.name: Karos Razok
6323-accept.text:
One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
6323-accept.title: Ride to the Undercity

6323-complete.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-complete.text: An order from the Sepulcher?  Very well.  It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
6323-complete.title: Ride to the Undercity

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

6324-accept.name: Michael Garrett
6324-accept.text:
The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok.  If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.

Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.

You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there.  Speak with me again when you are ready.
6324-accept.title: Return to Podrig

6395-complete.name: Novice Elreth
6395-complete.text: You have done a good deed today, $N.  Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place. As a token of my gratitude, please take one of these manuals I found.
6395-complete.title: Marla's Last Wish

6395-progress.name: Novice Elreth
6395-progress.text: We must respect our dead, $N.  It is one of the ways in which we differ from the Scourge...
6395-progress.title: Marla's Last Wish

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

8-accept.name: Calvin Montague
8-accept.text:
Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?

I got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.

Anyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
8-accept.title: A Rogue's Deal

8-complete.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-complete.text:
Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.

What? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?

Well, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!

Come back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.

Next thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.
8-complete.title: A Rogue's Deal

8-progress.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

832-accept.name: Unknown
832-accept.text:
<Words emanate from the pendant and into your mind.>

Gazz'uz?

Gazz'uz...report!

There is word of your discovery in Skull Rock.  You must prepare for an attack!

Gazz'uz, I order you to speak!  Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.

Do not test your skills against Neeru...

...Gazz'uz, are you there...?
832-accept.title: Burning Shadows

832-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-complete.text:
<Examines the Eye of Burning Shadow.>

Intriguing.  The voice you heard mentioned my name?  I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out.  Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.

I must study this pendant.  I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.

Thank you for bringing this to my attention, $N.  You have done your people a great service.
832-complete.title: Burning Shadows

832-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-progress.text: You have something vital to report.  I can sense it behind your eyes.
832-progress.title: Burning Shadows

840-accept.name: Takrin Pathseeker
840-accept.text:
Hmm, you look pretty strong.

Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.

Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
840-accept.title: Conscript of the Horde

840-complete.name: Kargal Battlescar
840-complete.text:
Oh, so Takrin sent you? He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.

I'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.
840-complete.title: Conscript of the Horde

840-progress.name: Kargal Battlescar
840-progress.text: What do you want, pup? If you're not here for recruitment, I don't have time for you.
840-progress.title: Conscript of the Horde

842-accept.name: Kargal Battlescar
842-accept.text:
Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.

You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...
842-accept.title: Crossroads Conscription

842-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
842-complete.text:
Alright, $N. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.

 I see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.
842-complete.title: Crossroads Conscription

842-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
842-progress.text: Well well well, what do we have here? Has Kargal deemed me worthy of another recruit?
842-progress.title: Crossroads Conscription

844-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-accept.text:
Your first prey will be easy.

The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
844-accept.title: Plainstrider Menace

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95328-progress.name: Father Lankester
95328-progress.text: Do you have something for me, $c?
95328-progress.title: Whispering Horror Residue

96898-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
96898-accept.title: Remnants of War

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97960-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97960-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97960-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97960-complete.name: Rand Rhobart
97960-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97960-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

99-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-accept.text:
As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool.  I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.

My knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village.  By day, the peasants appear to be Human.  But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.

I need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them.  Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, $N.
99-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
99153-progress.title: The One That Got Away

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol
